title: Time Jump: 17:00 CT, Beloit Confirmed, Story Is Live

fields.scenarioTitle: Six Days Out — MES Ransomware, Materiality & Disclosure
fields.narration: It is now 17:00 Central Time, 18:00 Eastern, on Thursday, March 25, 2027. We are compressing the evening for play. Here is what has changed since the last card. Blackwater Cyber has confirmed encryption at Plant 2 Beloit as well as at the Rockford data center. The board portal is still down because single sign-on is still isolated. The Rock River Gazette has published its story online under the headline 'Ironcrest hit by cyberattack; plants scramble, data reportedly stolen.' Ravi Menon's recovery tracker shows the MES heading for a missed 8-hour RTO at 22:05, and Blackwater Cyber has still not cleared a backup. Joliet has shipped no parts orders since 15:30. The 24-hour RTO for shipping runs out at 15:30 tomorrow, Friday. Rockford, Beloit and Dubuque are still running in manual mode with no lot tracking, so every hour comes out of each plant's 5-day finished-goods buffer. The attackers' 72-hour deadline runs out at about 14:05 Central Time on Sunday, March 28. Their ransom note now shows a countdown timer and a 'chat with support' link. The public story, the wider scope and the ransom clock now all land on the Crisis Management Team at once. Exercise aid, not legal advice.
worldState: Clock: 17:00 CT / 18:00 ET, Thursday, March 25, 2027. Six days to quarter end.
Scope: Encryption is CONFIRMED at Rockford (ICM-MES-01, ICM-MES-02, ICM-FS-03, ICM-FS-04) and at Plant 2 Beloit. The Dubuque replica ICM-MES-DBQ-01 is still partly encrypted (3 of 7 volumes).
Backups: None cleared for restore. Blackwater Cyber's persistence sweep still needs 12 to 18 hours. The last clean MES snapshot is from Wednesday at 07:05.
Recovery tracker (clock started 14:05): MES 4-hour checkpoint at 18:05, 8-hour RTO at 22:05, projected RED. MTPD for the MES is 24 hours (14:05 Friday).
Shipping (Joliet): Zero parts orders shipped since 15:30, against a normal 4,100 a day. The 24-hour RTO runs out at 15:30 Friday. MASL is 60 percent of normal orders.

Plants 1 to 3: Controllers are in manual mode, with no work orders and no lot tracking. Each plant is drawing down its 5-day finished-goods buffer. The largest customers hold under 10 days of inventory.
ERP integration: Still locked. Cause (encryption or isolation) not yet determined.
Board portal: Still down because SSO is isolated. The privileged notice to the Audit Committee Chair has not been delivered. Automatic retries are continuing.
Media: The Rock River Gazette story is live online: 'Ironcrest hit by cyberattack; plants scramble, data reportedly stolen.' No company statement has been issued.
Exfiltration: CONFIRMED from the Engineering Released share and the HR export folder. Contents and record counts are still UNKNOWN.
Ransom: 18 million dollars in cryptocurrency. The deadline is about 14:05 CT on Sunday, March 28, 2027. The note now shows a countdown timer and a 'chat with support' link. No one has used the link.
Disclosure Committee: The 19:00 CT meeting and the Harrow Fenn materiality worksheet are still pending.
fields.facilitatorNote: Hold play for 2 minutes so that every role can reset to 17:00. Ask the BCM to read out the tracker status for the MES, shipping and the finished-goods buffer, and ask the CEO to name the owner for each of the three new pressures: the published story, the Beloit scope and the ransom countdown.

instructorNote: This card resets the clock and stacks three pressures at once: the public story, the confirmed Beloit scope and the ransom countdown. Watch whether the BCM updates the tracker against each RTO and the 5-day buffer instead of hoping for a restore. Also watch whether anyone uses the attackers' chat link without a ransom decision made under policy, the sanctions screening and the insurer's consent.
